title: The Tennessee Ten, Slow Kid and Florence Mills
summary: The Tennessee Ten show band with Slow Kid, Florence Mills and Peggy Hollander, and a seasick Lake Michigan boat trip.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you ever know U.S. Thompson? A dancer? Called him Slow Kid?
Sure. He was, we was, we was together with Tennessee 10.
I know T-Boy Ballarang used to tell me about the Tennessee 10, but I don't know if he was with you or nothing.
When the new T-Boy used to run, we used to be on, on Sundays we used to go across the St. Joe, Michigan.

On the St. Joe. A big boat. And the last time we made that trip, across that Michigan Lake, that boat cracked us like firecrackers. It was a big boat. And they had a whole well of blue jackets on there. Sailors. Mm-hmm. And you know all them sailors were sick? Mm-hmm. Poor T-Boy is laid out on the floor. Ha, ha, ha. And I'm walking up there laughing at them people. Never did worry of me at all.

Everybody was sick. And I don't know, it didn't worry of me. I was walking up there. I mean, they were sick too. You know, make-believe. And them sailors, and I saw the man say, are you semen? Are you, you run out of the ship? I said, no. I don't understand you.
Who was in the Tennessee 10? How many people were that crew, that company?
John Mobley was a trombone man.
Wallace, uh... Geek was a planet man. And we had oil, violin player. My name, Johnson was a banjo player. I was on the bass. Florence Mills, she was singing. You knew Florence Mills, don't you?
I heard of her. All right. I remember.
Mm-hmm. Drama? Did you have a drama?
I knew you didn't hear him. He had an outfit who had a... bucket for a snare drum, a tub for the bass drum.
His name was Lou Gene. Oh. His nickname, Peggy.
Oh, he didn't have one leg or anything like that.
No, he wouldn't have liked Peggy. He wouldn't have liked Peggy, no.
No, he had good legs and could dance.
Well, what did Florence Mills sound like? I never heard of her.
Was she sweet or was she a shouter? Oh, what?
I've seen pictures of her. See? See, but I'm a young man.
But I don't know what you're talking about.
